name: Topological Landscape
definition: An approach of viewing contour information that uses the contour tree to build a 3D terrain model. Valleys illustrate events where a contour splits into two or more parts, and peaks represent where two or more contours merge.
summary: Topological Landscape maps scalar field connectivity to a 3D terrain, using peaks and valleys to encode merges and splits, offering an intuitive geometric metaphor distinct from abstract contour trees.
